metadata.question: When can the buyer terminate the PPA if the plant isn't running?

citations.quote: If Commercial Operation has not occurred by 31 December 2029 (the "Long-Stop Date"), the Buyer may terminate this Agreement by notice to the Generator.

sentences.text: The Buyer can terminate the PPA if the plant has not reached Commercial Operation by 31 December 2029, known as the Long-Stop Date.
